sources_considered.why: A low-credibility site that claims a neuro-symbolic model reached AGI. It names no source and nothing confirms it, so it is not reliable.
A journal article on neuro-symbolic routes to AGI. It discusses research directions, not a system that reached AGI, so it cannot settle the claim.
The speaker's own writing, which cannot be used as evidence that he was right.
A commentary piece arguing for an approach. It is not evidence that any AGI system exists.

unresolved_gaps: The search found no credible evidence that any system was widely recognised as AGI by 2026-10-28, so the event that would settle the claim has not happened.
Even if a system were declared AGI, there is no agreed AGI definition, and documentation of frontier systems' internal designs is limited.
